title: Worcester, MA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Worcester, MA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Worcester is a city in MA with a population of 206,518. Heart of the Commonwealth with colleges, cheaper than Boston, and New England seasons. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.1.
